name: MARVILON MEDTAS — Engineering Digital Thread, Decision Assurance & Release Orchestration
status: ACTIVE_ARCHITECTURE / K01 PILOT / BIDIRECTIONAL ADAPTERS IN PROGRESS
purpose: Connect engineering intent, native CAD, analysis, product data, technical decisions, manufacturing/inspection evidence and release state in a bidirectional, traceable and fail-closed workflow.
core_principles: No single file is the truth for the entire project; authority is partitioned by artifact class.
Every important requirement/decision/characteristic/evidence object receives a persistent ID.
Current state is derived from evidence; UI actions do not mark gates PASS by themselves.
Every write into CAD/product data is an explicit controlled command with backup/readback/verification.
Rejected alternatives and reasons remain first-class thread objects.
Feedback flows back from analysis/manufacturing/inspection/test to design, not only downstream from CAD.
Release is fail-closed when evidence is missing, stale, inconsistent or belongs to another geometry/input revision.

connectors: future SOLIDWORKS PDM/vault for multi-user native CAD

four_layers.responsibility: Artifact registry, persistent IDs, hashes, timestamps, source links, geometry/input fingerprints and event ledger.
State reducer, dependency graph, EDR/CI/RVM, 24-gate technical filter, change impact and fail-closed release logic.
Command Center, engineering dossier, production release board, drawing assurance, team review and AI Handoff.

solidworks_to_center: future save/rebuild/document-change event hooks and geometry fingerprints
solidworks_bidirectional_contract.write_rule: No background geometry/property write without an explicit MEDTAS command. Readback evidence is mandatory after each controlled write.
